headline: Weathered Expanse Battles Escalate as Wardens Secure Mooring County
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, combat in the Weathered Expanse has sharply escalated, inflicting nearly two thousand combined casualties within the past two hours as bitter fighting over Wightwalk, Frostmarch, and Crow's Nest leaves four strategic positions neutralized. In Mooring County, where fierce exchanges previously churned through outposts, engagements have cooled markedly as Warden forces established total control across all twelve strategic bases. Across the Stlican Shelf, tactical shifts have settled following earlier contests around Briar and Breaker Town, though casualty tallies continue to mount. Meanwhile, severe friction persists across static frontlines without immediate boundary adjustments; Linn of Mercy and Nevish Line report surging casualty rates with hundreds fallen in the latest two-hour span, while Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle log accelerating skirmishes against heavily defended sectors.
